tasks.old_behavior:
line_log_print() printed a blank-line separator unconditionally before each diff block using fprintf(rev->diffopt.file, "%s
", prefix). The commit header was followed by a blank line before the diff started.
tasks.new_behavior: line_log_queue_pairs() only queues pre-computed filepairs; show_log() and separator emission is deferred to log_tree_diff_flush(). log_tree_diff_flush() only emits the blank-line separator for verbose headers. Non-verbose (--oneline) output no longer has an extra blank line before the diff.
tasks.compatibility_reason: Scripts or tools that parse git log -L output and depend on a blank line between the commit header and the diff will see one fewer blank line. Test expectations confirm this: expect files removed blank lines that were previously unconditional. The test  explicitly validates this new behavior.
tasks.test_recommendation: Run git log -L with various formats (--oneline, --format=, default) and verify blank-line behavior matches the new expectations. Use existing t4211-line-log.sh tests as regression.

tasks.old_behavior: git log -L with --full-diff was either silently accepted (possibly with confusing results since -L pre-computes filepairs scoped to tracked line ranges) or rejected with the generic message "-L does not yet support diff formats besides -p and -s" if combined with incompatible format flags.
tasks.new_behavior: git log -L --full-diff is explicitly rejected with die("-L does not yet support the requested diff format"). The error message also changed to be more general.
tasks.compatibility_reason: Users who previously invoked git log -L --full-diff (possibly in scripts or aliases) will now get a fatal error instead of any output. This is a tightening of CLI input validation.
tasks.test_recommendation: Run git log -L --full-diff and verify it exits with error. Test is included in t4211-line-log.sh.

tasks.old_behavior: When using git log -L with -S/-G/--find-object/--diff-filter, show_log() was called inside line_log_print() before diffcore_std() ran. This meant pickaxe could not suppress commit headers even when no diff pairs survived filtering. All commits in the range were shown.
tasks.new_behavior: show_log() is now deferred until after diffcore_std() inside log_tree_diff_flush(). Pickaxe (-S, -G, --find-object) and --diff-filter now properly suppress commits when all pairs are filtered out. Commits without matching content changes are omitted from output.
tasks.compatibility_reason: Scripts using git log -L with pickaxe options that previously saw all commits in the range will now see fewer commits (only those matching the pickaxe pattern). This changes the output contract for a documented option combination.
tasks.test_recommendation: Run the t4211-line-log.sh tests for -L with -G, -S, --find-object, and --diff-filter. Verify commits are properly suppressed with non-matching patterns.
